title: Trip to Montseratt
text: It was an easy and relaxing day trip to Montserrat. Julia was friendly and helpful!
author: Jason_Poh

title: Small Group, Well Planned!
text:
Great experience, it was a small group, so we manage to move around faster and covered more ground. The access to view and do our prayers in front of the statue was also something special.

Julia was a great guide and made sure everyone is taken care off.
author: MamaPoh

title: An incredible walk through time!
text: We had the best tour with Julia! She was so knowledgeable and passionate about the history of Barcelona and more. And very well spoken too. Julia somehow made our tour feel like we were walking through history with an old wise friend…we definitely would recommend a tour with her!
author: Lise444

title: Wonderful Historical Tour
text: Our tour guide, Ivan, was great. He was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic. It was interesting to learn the history and architecture of Barcelona and the Gothic district
